mission: Implement consequential remaining functionality from the comprehensive plan and beads, committing meaningful increments directly to main through the authorized GitHub connector without PRs.

priority_findings: Advancing source sequences could establish usable coverage even when decoded images were frozen, persistently clipped, or otherwise degraded; existing fixed health screening was not integrated into live daemon admission.
The RTSP driver assigned delayed or reordered AVC pictures the bytes, digest and timestamp of the access unit that released them, and discarded delayed output at EOF.
basis.bead_disposition: Broad proof and qualification beads remain open. Live implementation advances are not a claim that every physical-camera or absence-evidence requirement has been qualified.

delivered.behavior: Bounded receipts are packed in the same publication as paired coverage/liveness deltas, both naming the exact receipt digest. Empty/oversized evidence is refused before publication; existing unscreened request identity is preserved.

delivered.feature: Original AVC source binding, decode-order custody, and clean EOF drain
delivered.behavior: Native decode indexes join each picture to original access-unit bytes, digest, RTP PTS and host receipt. Bounded decode-order emission keeps the archive independently decodable. Clean EOF drains accepted input and delayed pictures; malformed/ambiguous/lost input explicitly closes the generation.

delivered.feature: Opt-in live visual-degradation coverage and perception holds
delivered.behavior: The existing conservative-v1 screen runs independently of inference. Findings and refusals withhold coverage and cognition while source recording continues. Eight fresh clear measurements and independent continuity are required for recovery. Old camera observations are invalidated, excluded buffered frames cannot re-enter cognition, and each same-poll health transition retains an ordered receipt. Parent cancellation and fixed work/memory limits remain explicit.

authority.repository: Direct-main commits explicitly authorized; reference updates use observed expected heads with force=false. Concurrent commits were merged and preserved.
authority.runtime: No new independent authority root. Pure measurement checks existing process cancellation; publication uses existing storage authority. The visual policy remains explicit opt-in.
authority.network: No real camera, vendor cloud, or device-management operation was performed. The actual-driver loopback regression was authored but not executed.
authority.release: No dependency features, toolchain pins, qualification gates, or release claims were weakened. No additional dependencies were introduced.

native_avc_helper.scope: Exact production avc_decode.rs and its six helper tests with real fss-core, fss-packet and fss-codec-h264 path dependencies. Real checked-in B-pyramid and multislice fixtures. No mocked codec or packet behavior.
native_avc_helper.harness_changes: Only the daemon-dependent network test submodule was omitted and fixture include paths were made absolute in a temporary harness. Production files were unchanged.

Source time reversal and pending-byte admission bound

native_daemon.result: Repeated rustc SIGKILL during unchanged upstream asupersync 0.5.0 compilation; first full-test build also hit SIGKILL in fss-core. No successful changed-daemon typecheck or integration-test execution.
native_daemon.settings: One Cargo worker, debug info disabled, incremental disabled, exact pinned compiler and dependencies; final attempt additionally used -Zthreads=1 -Zmir-opt-level=0 --jobs-backend=1.
native_daemon.environment: Shared memory and disk pressure caused executor disconnects. Builds were moved to disk-backed cache/target storage; the executor recovered, but the Asupersync boundary remained blocked. Visible limits did not expose a confirmable hard memory cap.
